aiDescription.summary: This Senate resolution directs the Secretary of State to submit within 30 days a 502B(c) statement on Ghana's human rights practices prepared with DRL and State Legal Adviser. It seeks details on alleged abuses (arrest/detention, torture, disappearances, killings, trafficking), treatment of non‑Ghanaians sent to Ghana by the U.S., U.S. security‑assistance risks and assurances, detention‑condition analyses, names of persons sent in 2025–26, and 2025–26 U.S.–Ghana meetings.

description.text: A resolution requesting information on the Republic of Ghana's human rights practices pursuant to section 502B(c) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961.

impact.summary: The resolution directs the Secretary of State, with the State Department’s Assistant Secretary for Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor and the Legal Adviser, to submit a 502B(c) report on Ghana to the Senate Foreign Relations and House Foreign Affairs Committees within 30 days. It must detail abuses and treatment of non‑Ghanaians removed to Ghana by the United States, U.S.–Ghana agreements or payments, security‑assistance risks, and 2025–2026 meetings.

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations. (text: CR S961-962)
